sources.title: M-VAVE - Product Ecosystem
sources.excerpt: M-VAVE's official Product Ecosystem provides the manufacturer's complete lineup and includes its CUVAVE/M-VAVE effect-pedal catalog. The named FUZZ model appears in that product family, establishing the exact product name within the maker's lineup.
